# clio.css

> CSS library for classic Mac OS interfaces: Macintosh System 6, System 7, Mac OS 8.5 Drawing Board (the withdrawn beta theme) and Mac OS 8/9 Platinum. Windows, title bars, menu bars and menus, push buttons, check boxes, radio buttons, text fields, pop-up menus, list boxes, scroll bars, dialogs and alerts, group boxes, progress bars, tabs, the Control Strip and desktop icons: 32 components. Pure CSS; an optional script, `dist/clio.js`, adds what CSS cannot (menu tracking, scroll bars, window dragging, the text caret, sounds). MIT licence; no Apple screenshots or font files. Every value is traced to its source and labelled measured (read from real pixels of the era), inferred, adapted or third-party.

Install: `npm install clio.css` or `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/clio.css@1.1.1/dist/clio.css">`.
Optional script: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/clio.css@1.1.1/dist/clio.js" defer></script>`.
System 6 is the default; add `data-era="system7"`, `data-era="drawingboard"` or `data-era="platinum"` to `<html>` or any element. Single-era builds: `dist/clio.system6.css`, `dist/clio.system7.css`, `dist/clio.drawingboard.css`, `dist/clio.platinum.css`. NeXTSTEP 3.3 is its own file, `dist/clio.nextstep.css` (never in `clio.css`): the menu bar becomes the vertical main menu, the collapse box the miniaturize button, the zoom box the resize bar.
All rules use `:where()` or one class, so author CSS always wins; every value is a `--clio-*` custom property.
Drop-in for system.css markup (.window, .title-bar button.close, .btn, .btn-default, .standard-dialog, .modal-dialog, .alert-box, .field-row, role="menu-bar").

## Docs

- [Documentation and live examples](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/): every component with markup, tokens and evidence
- [Component index (JSON)](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/components.json): selectors, tokens, HTML and evidence per component
- [Full reference for LLMs](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/llms-full.txt): all component markup plus the complete stylesheet
- [README](https://github.com/surfine/clio.css#readme)

## Components

- [Window](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#window): A document window: frame, title bar with close and zoom boxes (plus the WindowShade box in Platinum), an optional details bar and a scrolling pane. System 7 adds colour to the frame and title bar.
- [Menu bar and menus](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#menu): The menu bar across the top of the screen and its pull-down menus: items, keyboard shortcuts, check marks, separators, disabled items and submenus.
- [Push button](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#button): Push buttons, the default button with its ring, the pressed state and the disabled state. Styles <button>, .btn and input buttons.
- [Check box](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#checkbox): A check box drawn on the native <input type=checkbox>; no extra label markup needed.
- [Radio button](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#radio): A radio button drawn on the native <input type=radio>.
- [Text field](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#text-field): Single-line inputs and <textarea>.
- [Pop-up menu](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#select): A <select> drawn as the era's pop-up menu; <select multiple> or size>1 becomes a list box.
- [List box](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#listbox): A scrolling list with one or more selected rows, as in the Open dialog.
- [Scroll bar](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#scrollbar): The era's scroll bar on every scroll area clio.css owns, on any element with .clio-scroll, or on the whole page with <html class="clio-scrollbars">.
- [Dialogs and alerts](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#dialog): The modal dialog frame, the alert layout with an icon, and the plain shadowed box.
- [Group box](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#fieldset): A <fieldset> with a <legend>, for grouping controls.
- [Progress bar](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#progress): The native <progress> element as the era's thermometer.
- [Tabs](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#tabs): A tab strip over a panel. Native in Platinum; an adaptation in System 6, which had no tab control.
- [Control Strip](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#control-strip): The Control Strip of System 7.5 to Mac OS 9: module buttons with menu triangles, scroll arrows and a tab that folds it away. Markup matches AI System 6's.
- [Desktop and icons](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#desktop): The desktop pattern and desktop icons with their name labels. Bring your own icon images; clio.css ships no Apple icons.
- [Disclosure triangle](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#disclosure): The triangle that shows and hides a list's or a dialog's details. A <details> summary gets it too.
- [List view](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#list-view): The Finder's list view: column headers with the sorted column marked, and rows of names and details.
- [Slider](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#slider): <input type=range> as the Appearance slider, with optional tick marks.
- [Little arrows](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#little-arrows): The up and down pair beside a number or a clock field.
- [Bevel button](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#bevel-button): A square bevelled button for an icon or a short label: push button, toggle (aria-pressed) or menu (class menu).
- [Chasing arrows](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#chasing-arrows): The asynchronous progress indicator: two arrows chasing round a circle.
- [Help button](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#help-button): The square button with the help icon in a dialog's lower left.
- [Image well](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#image-well): A sunken well holding a picture or an icon.
- [Help balloon](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#balloon): Balloon Help: a white balloon with a tail pointing at what it describes.
- [Rounded-corner window](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#rounded-window): The desk accessory's window (rDocProc): rounded corners and a black title bar, as the Calculator draws it in every Classic era.
- [Side-title utility window](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#side-utility-window): A floating window whose title bar runs down its left side (kWindowFloatSide*): close box at the top, collapse box at the foot.
- [Placard](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#placard): A framed strip for status or a small control at the foot of a window, beside the horizontal scroll bar.
- [Split bar](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#split-bar): The bar above a vertical scroll bar that splits a window into panes, and the split line between two panes.
- [Browser (NeXTSTEP)](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#browser): NeXTSTEP's column browser: lists side by side, each item that leads further marked with an arrow. NeXTSTEP only (clio.nextstep.css).
- [Pull-down list (NeXTSTEP)](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#pull-down): A button that opens a list of commands; its title stays the same. NeXTSTEP only.
- [Workspace dock (NeXTSTEP)](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#dock): The column of 64px application tiles at the screen's right edge; a docked application that is not running shows three dots. NeXTSTEP only.
- [Type and tokens](https://surfine.github.io/clio.css/#typography): The fonts, the palette and every --clio-* custom property you can override.
